CustomField.formula: IF( OR(ISPICKVAL(Sales_Manager_Approval_Status__c, "Sent"), ISPICKVAL(MD_Approval_Status__c, "Sent"), ISPICKVAL(Sales_Head_Approval_Status__c, "Sent")), "Under Approval", IF( OR(ISPICKVAL(Sales_Manager_Approval_Status__c, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(MD_Approval_Status__c, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Sales_Head_Approval_Status__c, "Rejected")), "Rejected", IF( OR(ISPICKVAL(Sales_Manager_Approval_Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(MD_Approval_Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Sales_Head_Approval_Status__c, "Approved")), "Approved", "No Discount" )))
CustomField.label: Cost Sheet Approval Summary
